title: Injecting Services
description: Learn how to inject services into controllers and other classes.

data.text: Services are typically injected through constructors. ASP.NET Core's DI container resolves dependencies automatically.

data.title: Constructor
FromServices
Prefer Constructor
data.text: Prefer constructor injection for dependencies used across multiple actions. Use [FromServices] for action-specific dependencies.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Constructor injection is the preferred approach.
